answer.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ despite prior success with both onboarding simplification and activation messaging. Verifying memory_91 (activation messaging impact on week-one engagement) and memory_86 (shortened onboarding improved adoption) will confirm whether these prior interventions remain effective or have degraded. Activation messaging is the highest-leverage play here because: (1) it directly targets the reported 6% activation decline, (2) it showed durable engagement lift without retention risk in prior work, (3) it complements the onboarding simplification already in place (memory_31), and (4) it avoids the strategic hazard of matching competitor pricing, which risks margin and trains customers to expect discounts. Referral incentives require established customer base engagement and won't address the acute activation problem. Enterprise sales assist is orthogonal to the SMB segment pressure. A standard experiment allows signal detection while reserving optionality if results are weak. This preserves the option to pivot to pricing or other levers in future cycles.
